data.title: 陆八魔阿露 · 雨夜站台的风衣近距避雨
data.description: 下着倾盆大雨的车站屋檐下，霓虹倒影在湿漉的街道上。阿露披着敞开的卡其色硬派风衣，内穿贴身红黑毛衣。雨风微凉，她小心翼翼地往老师身边挪了挪脚步，双手缩在风衣口袋里。泛红的小脸在霓虹水光中带着几分别扭与遮掩不住的欢喜，嘴硬地声称这只是恶党照顾下属的惯例。
data.location: city train station shelter on a rainy night with glowing neon reflections
data.action: standing close under station overhang, beige trench coat fluttering open, hands in pockets, looking sideways with sweet blushing smile under umbrella
data.lighting: cool blue and red neon street reflections mixed with warm station canopy light
data.mood: heartwarming tsundere date, romantic rainy city intimacy
data.promptProse: Standing close under a rain-sheltered train station canopy at night, Rikuhachima Aru wears an open beige trench coat. Neon lights reflect in the puddles as she glances up with a sweet, flustered blush.
data.animaCaption: Aru standing under a train station roof on a rainy night in a trench coat, blushing cutely.
